environment.description: Linux real PTY runtime with installed Bash and /bin/sh; C-D55 excludes conda-specific and cgroup requirements

items.evidence: check-cw07-runtime-final.log: real Bash and /bin/sh PTYs both passed takeover_and_environment and fresh_handoff_no_replay. Takeover request immediately held dispatch, confirmation occurred against the live experiment foreground before exit/prompt, user input was delivered to the confirmed target, input barrier/control return remained distinct, and a fresh handoff did not replay the old request.

check-cw07-runtime-final.log: real Bash and /bin/sh preserved the parent control process and explicit lifecycle while separate supervisor/experiment groups ran. Unsubmitted input, REPL/foreground, manual job, unsupported hook/trap, and control-loss unknown cases each held automation with explicit reasons; input barrier and control return were observed; owned PID residue was empty.

check-cw07-runtime-final.log: both real shells inherited the user-prepared temporary cwd, PATH, and exported marker value 'prepared'; application-only and private boundary variables were unset in the experiment, and child-local changes did not replace the parent state.
